subcategory_description: When a business has to register for GST, and the turnover levels that apply.
label: GST turnover threshold
context: A business or enterprise must register for GST when its GST turnover reaches this amount, or when it expects to reach it in its first year. GST turnover is gross business income minus the GST included in sales.

subcategory_description: When a business has to register for GST, and the turnover levels that apply.
label: GST turnover threshold, non-profit organisations
context: A non-profit organisation must register for GST when its GST turnover is this amount a year or more.

subcategory_description: When a business has to register for GST, and the turnover levels that apply.
label: Days to register after reaching the threshold
context: Once registration is required, it has to be done within this many days.

subcategory_description: When a business has to register for GST, and the turnover levels that apply.
label: Minimum time to stay registered after choosing to register
context: A business below the threshold can choose to register, and generally must then stay registered for at least this long.

subcategory_description: When a business has to register for GST, and the turnover levels that apply.
label: Longest period a GST registration can be backdated
context: A registration can be backdated by up to this long, unless there is fraud or evasion.

subject_intro: A business must register for GST when its turnover reaches {fact:au_gst_threshold}, or {fact:au_gst_threshold_nonprofit} for a non-profit. Taxi and ride-sourcing drivers must always register.
subject_meta_description: When a business must register for GST in Australia: the {fact:au_gst_threshold} turnover threshold, {fact:au_gst_threshold_nonprofit} for non-profits, and how long you have to register.
